links.outcome: Field-level extraction accuracy against reference labels on held-out oral cancer records
links.effect: Average normalized field accuracy 79.97% and precision 73.45% after excluding sparse fields; across all 24 fields accuracy 70.37%; lastFU accuracy about 9.44%.
links.quote: across all 24 fields, average accuracy was \((70.37%)\).

screen.reason: The study evaluates an LLM pipeline (fine-tuned Llama-3.1 and Gemma) on retrospective clinical text datasets for information extraction and summarization, assessing extraction accuracy without evaluating a deployment practice or organizational safeguard.
